operations.label: Branch: dry run — screenshot and return without importing
operations.summary: If input.dryRun=true: takes a form screenshot (label: onbase-dry-run-pre-import), sets status='Dry Run Complete', returns early — Import button is never clicked
operations.note: dryRun is set by the OCR fan-out (OnbaseInput.dryRun). Dry run still walks the full form including keyset autofill + keyword verification.

operations.label: Assert Import button is enabled before clicking
operations.summary: isImportEnabled() calls .isEnabled() on the Import button; throws if false — refuses to import when the form is not ready

Wait for network idle after import submission
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', {timeout:15000}); error is swallowed with .catch(()=>{}) — best-effort settle

notes: Fan-out target only: the operator never starts onbase directly. Upload path creates an operation coordinator row + delegates an OCR prep row; on OCR approve, one operation-member row per approved person is fanned out to this workflow.
deferAuth+authSteps:false: loginToOnBase is called explicitly at the authenticate step (after OCR approval), so the operator is not prompted for Duo before reviewing OCR results.
betweenItems:[reset]: the OnBase browser page is reset to about:blank between persons so a stuck import form from person N cannot leak into person N+1.

Keyset autofill is load-bearing: typing UCPath ID + Tab populates all required keyword fields except Document Name. Fallback keyword fill (from OCR/person-lookup data) is the exception path for bad/unknown UCPath IDs.
Dry run boundary: dryRun=true causes the import step to screenshot + return without clicking Import — never commits a real document. The full form including keyset verification still runs.
Operation coordinator row is display-only (no daemon task); only the fanned-out operation-member rows execute this handler.

ONBASE_REQUIRED_KEYWORDS: [UCPath ID, Last Name, First Name, Document Name, Department Name, Department Code, Vice Chancellor, Vice Chancellor Code]. The assert at the end of fill-keywords ensures all are non-empty before the import step.
